stories.title: Sources: Giants QB Dart out for extended period, possibly rest of season
stories.summary: Jaxson Dart's knee injury is more severe than originally anticipated, and the Giants QB could miss the rest of the season, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.

stories.title: Raptors, Leonard agree to 2-year, $115M extension
stories.summary: Toronto Raptors star Kawhi Leonard has agreed on a two-year, $115 million contract extension with the franchise, plus a player option for the 2028-29 season, his agent Harrison Gaines of SLASH Sports told ESPN on Tuesday.

stories.title: Sources: Bagent has concussion, leaving Bears' QB situation muddled
stories.summary: Bears quarterback Tyson Bagent is in the NFL's concussion protocol, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport on Tuesday.

stories.title: Yankees don't expect Judge (calf) to play in wild-card series
stories.summary: Aaron Judge is not expected to be available for the Yankees' wild-card series as he continues to recover from a calf strain.

stories.title: Packers lose top O-lineman Bako-Bewele to season-ending surgery
stories.summary: Packers RT Zach Bako-Bewele, considered the team's best offensive lineman, is set to undergo knee surgery that will sideline him for 8-10 months.
